table.note: The query keeps the stars with a photometric distance above zero (the table gives one only for RR Lyrae, and writes 0 for some) whose probability of belonging to the Sagittarius stream is above 0.9 (ProbSGR, the authors' own number; the threshold is a presentation choice). Each sits at its own distance, measured to about 9%: that error stretches every clump along the line to the Sun.

meaning: RR Lyrae stars of the Sagittarius dwarf galaxy and the stream of stars it leaves around the Milky Way, from Ramos et al.'s (2022) Gaia EDR3 sample: one dot per star at its measured sky position and distance.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the warm white of the Milky Way's RR Lyrae dots, at the field's 1 px size.
